weight_contract.linear: finite nonnegative values with positive sum
weight_contract.log: natural-log weights normalized by logsumexp; negative infinity is allowed for zero support, while NaN and positive infinity are rejected

row_semantics: One weighted impact-posterior particle per row. Extra identity and model columns are preserved only through the input hash.
planner_semantics: The planner does not update posterior weights. It smooths the supplied weighted point population onto equal-area local tiles for decision sensitivity.
